name: zmodel_set_texture_world_per_meter
description: zModel::SetTextureWorldPerMeter stores the global U/V world-units-per-meter scale for texture projection.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476090 validates a stdcall leaf that stores the two stack arguments to g_zModel_TextureWorldPerMeterU and g_zModel_TextureWorldPerMeterV and returns with callee cleanup for 8 bytes.
The native smoke verifies both per-meter globals are updated and that the base globals are not modified by this setter.
